record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The eight units in appliesTo declare HORN_LEECH: four Deerling forms (1 star) and four Sawsbuck forms (2 stars). All declare passive SEASONAL, which is NOT covered here (the queue marks it as having no PassiveEffects entry; see the passive/SEASONAL record). The strategy is shared; the unit differences are the star count (table index) and stats such as atk.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target equal to a star multiplier (2 / 2 / 3 / 5 for 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 stars) times the caster's current attack, then heals the caster for 50% of the damage actually taken by the target (rounded). If that heal exceeds the caster's missing HP, half of the surplus (rounded) is added as shield. Deerling (1 star) uses x2 and Sawsbuck (2 stars) also x2.

targeting.who: the cast target chosen before the cast (the strategy never changes it); requiresTarget is true
targeting.note: No movement and no retargeting in the strategy. The heal goes to the caster only.

effects.scaling: raw damage = multiplier x pokemon.atk at the moment of the cast (atk buffs count); then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division and later untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (takenDamage 0). takenDamage is the amount handleDamage reports, which is used for the heal.

effects.scaling: Math.round(0.5 x takenDamage); handleHeal is called with apBoost 0 and crit false, so no AP or crit scaling, but the heal then passes handleHeal's modifiers: none if the caster is wounded or protected, x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burned, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 under ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP
effects.resolution: the Grass-synergy max-HP conversion of overheal inside handleHeal was seen but its effect on this cast was not examined

shields.scaling: overheal = max(0, round(0.5 x takenDamage) - (maxHP - hp)) using the UNMODIFIED heal and the HP before healing; shield = Math.round(0.5 x overheal) via addShield(…, 0, false): no AP or crit scaling; halved if the caster is enraged; passes the entity's held-item hook
shields.condition: only when overheal > 0, i.e. when the unmodified heal exceeds the caster's missing HP
shields.note: because overheal ignores handleHeal's modifiers (wound, burn, enraged, ZENITH), a wounded caster still gets the shield computed from the unmodified heal even though it received no heal

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (3) and 4-star (5) columns are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the eight units (1 and 2). Deerling and Sawsbuck therefore both declare the x2 multiplier; their different damage comes only from stats (atk). Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy. The cast needs a target (requiresTarget true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast reads the caster's current atk and HP.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: multiplier 2 (1 and 2 stars) x atk. The damage dealt is raw x (1 + AP/100), then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; the heal is 50% of the damage the target actually took (rounded) after handleHeal's modifiers; the shield is 50% of the unmodified overheal.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage and takenDamage after handleDamage's modifiers (shields, items, damage reduction, resurrection, field multipliers) - handleDamage was not read in detail; the heal depends on that takenDamage
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were located
Whether a target's shield absorbs damage before takenDamage is counted (affecting the heal) was not traced
unresolved: Passive SEASONAL is declared by all eight units but has no PassiveEffects entry according to the queue routing; how it changes the unit (if anything beyond the unit definition) is not covered
Whether takenDamage returned by handleDamage excludes damage absorbed by a shield or overkill was not read
The Grass-synergy max HP conversion of overheal in handleHeal was not examined
Whether applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff alters the shield value was not read
Whether the eight units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
